description: Source code for handling triggers and interrupts for the TMag5170 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: tmag5170_handle_interrupts
methods.description: Handles sensor interrupts by invoking the registered data-ready handler if set.

methods.name: tmag5170_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the trigger and handler for data-ready events.

methods.name: tmag5170_trigger_init
methods.description: Initializes the trigger mechanism, configures GPIO, and sets up threading or work handling based on configuration.
